lines.text: Priests and Levites ask John who he is, and he says he is not the Christ, Elijah, or the Prophet.
John answers in the words of Isaiah the prophet, calling himself a voice in the wilderness.
The Pharisees ask John why he baptizes, and he says he baptizes with fire.
At Bethany beyond the Jordan, John sees Jesus the next day and calls Him the Lamb of God.
John says he saw the Spirit descend like an eagle and testifies that Jesus is the Son of God.
